spells.auraDescription: Reduces Magic resistances by 60. Increases Magic damage taken by 8%.

spells.auraDescription: Reduces Magic resistances by 75. Increases Magic damage taken by 10%.

spells.name: Ice Lance
spells.description: Deals 26 to 30 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets.

spells.name: Summon Hawk
spells.description: Summons a hawk.

spells.name: Improved Seal of Fury
spells.description: When Seal of Fury's shield is fully absorbed, restore 0 Mana, increased by 15% per level the attacker is above you, up to 45%.

spells.name: Wrack
spells.description: Tears the target apart from within, inflicting 36 Shadow damage every 1 sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by 10% for 6 sec.
spells.auraDescription: Inflicts 36 Shadow damage every 1 sec and increases damage taken from the caster's other Shadow damage over time effects by 10%.

spells.name: Death Mark
spells.description:
Finishing move that marks the target, storing a portion of the damage dealt by your attacks per Combo Point. Garrote and Rupture damage is stored at twice the rate. After 6 sec, the stored damage is dealt, up to a maximum increased by Attack Power and Critical Strike chance:
   1 point  : ${1*$<ratio>}% stored, ${((63+(1*102)+1*$<maxAP>*$apm)*($mcrit/100+1))*$<coup>} damage cap
   2 points: ${2*$<ratio>}% stored, ${((63+(2*102)+2*$<maxAP>*$apm)*($mcrit/100+1))*$<coup>} damage cap
   3 points: ${3*$<ratio>}% stored, ${((63+(3*102)+3*$<maxAP>*$apm)*($mcrit/100+1))*$<coup>} damage cap
   4 points: ${4*$<ratio>}% stored, ${((63+(4*102)+4*$<maxAP>*$apm)*($mcrit/100+1))*$<coup>} damage cap
   5 points: ${5*$<ratio>}% stored, ${((63+(5*102)+5*$<maxAP>*$apm)*($mcrit/100+1))*$<coup>} damage cap
spells.auraDescription: Marked for Death. Taking 0 damage after 6 sec.

spells.description: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 92 Holy damage to an enemy, or 425 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.

spells.description: When you cast a healing spell, gain Mana equal to 20% of the base cost of the spell if your previous heal was a different spell.

spells.name: Strider Kick
spells.description: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec.

spells.name: Furious Precision
spells.description: Increases your chance to hit with off-hand attacks by 10%.

spells.name: Mana Tide Totem
spells.description: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for ${$d-1} sec that restores 290 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

spells.name: Dark Inspiration
spells.description: Your Mind Blast and fully channeled Mind Flay causes Dark Inspiration, increasing yours and your party's Spirit by 15% for 10 sec.

spells.name: Shieldsworn
spells.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Holy Strike ability by 4 sec. Additionally, Holy Strike now strikes with your shield, triggering your active Holy Shield and Shield Specialization talents without consuming their charges or triggering their cooldowns, and allowing you to Block spells for 6 sec.

spells.name: Stoicism
spells.description: Reduces the duration of Stun and Charm effects on you by 20%.

spells.name: Oath of Light
spells.description: Swear an Oath to protect target ally for 5 min, increasing the healing of your Holy Light on them by up to 0, your Flash of Light by up to 0, and your Holy Shock by up to 0. Only one Oath of Light may be sworn by the Paladin at any one time.
spells.auraDescription: Receives increased healing from the caster's Holy Light by up to 0, Flash of Light by up to 0, and Holy Shock by up to 0.

spells.name: Holy Binding
spells.description: Each time you heal a target other than yourself with Flash Heal, you are healed for 50% as much. This healing generates no threat.

spells.name: Predatory Discipline
spells.description: Your Ferocious Bite ability no longer converts extra Energy into damage, but still deals extra damage based on your excess Energy.

spells.name: Lacerate
spells.description: Lacerates the enemy target, making them bleed for 30 damage over 15 sec plus 10% weapon damage per existing application of Lacerate on the target. Causes a high amount of threat. This effect stacks up to 5 times on the same target.

spells.name: Lacerate
spells.description: Lacerates the enemy target, making them bleed for 20 damage over 15 sec plus 10% weapon damage per existing application of Lacerate on the target. Causes a high amount of threat. This effect stacks up to 5 times on the same target.

spells.name: Ferocious Bite
spells.description:
Finishing move that causes damage per combo point and converts each extra point of energy into 0.7 additional damage.  Damage is increased by your Attack Power.
   1 point  : 40-54 damage
   2 points: 70-84 damage
   3 points: 100-114 damage
   4 points: 130-144 damage
   5 points: 160-174 damage

spells.name: Bloom
spells.description: When your Rejuvenation or Regrowth spell expires due to its duration, the target is instantly healed for an amount equal to 100% of your Spirit. If either spell expires due to being dispelled, the target is healed for 50% of your Spirit instead.

spells.name: Blood Splatter

spells.name: Composure

spells.name: Quick Getaway

spells.name: Boot Knife
